sourceMaterial.sourceEvidence: PO Ownership: Leading the Value Chain; Owning Product Portfolio Value. PO Value: Optimising the Value Chain; Optimising Product Portfolio Value. Leader Value: Measuring Success Through Efficiency; Monitoring Delivery Performance. Leader System: Managing Through Structure; Coordinating Organisational Execution.
sourceMaterial.relationshipLogic: PO behaviours may indicate product or portfolio value leadership, while Leader behaviours may indicate a stronger focus on efficiency, performance monitoring, or structural coordination. This may suggest that product leadership and organisational priorities are not fully aligned.
